 WLOX announces Game of the Week, releases new top 10 rankings ahead of Week 11 
 By Matt DeGregorio Published : Nov. 1, 2026 at 8:25 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BILOXI, Miss. (WLOX) — The WLOX Week 11 high school football rankings have been unveiled.
 Gulfport 
 D’Iberville 
 Poplarville 
 Pass Christian 
 Picayune 
 St. Martin 
 Pearl River Central 
 Hancock 
 Greene County 
 East Central 
 Receiving votes: Ocean Springs, Stone, Gautier, Biloxi
 Analysis:
 To no one’s surprise, Gulfport takes over the top spot in the Week 11 poll while D’Iberville drops to number two after its 28-24 loss to the Admirals. Poplarville and Pass Christian stay at number three and four respectively. The two sides enter the 4A playoffs with undefeated records following district championships. Picayune sits fifth after winning its sixth straight region title while St. Martin stays at number six following a bye week. Despite Hancock clinching a top two seed and having won against Pearl River Central, the voters have the Blue Devils ranked one spot ahead of the Hawks. Greene County enters the playoffs sitting 9th in the rankings after finishing the regular season with a 7-3 record and East Central is in the poll with a chance to clinch a top two seed in the 5A playoffs.
 Week 11 WLOX Game of the Week: Pascagoula at Gautier 
 Analysis:
 With major 6A playoff implications on the line, WLOX is heading to the Singing River Classic between Pascagoula and Gautier. Last season, the Panthers moved to 14-10 all time against the Gators, however, Gautier has won four of the last six games against their rivals. With a win, Pascagoula clinches a playoff berth which would also eliminate the Gators from playoff contention. If Gautier wins, Pascagoula would be eliminated from the playoffs, and the Gators would need either Hancock to beat Long Beach or Picayune to beat Pearl River Central to clinch a playoff spot. We’ll have a full preview of the Week 11 WLOX Game of the Week on Wednesday night at 10pm ahead of the Friday Night Football Showdown which takes place on Thursday night this week.
